morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整借词使用，不拆成 tor-、-na- 或 -do。按马来语音值读三个音节，不套用英语的 /neɪ/ 双元音。

senses.zh_definition: 龙卷风：与云体相连并接触地面的强烈旋转气柱，常伴有漏斗状云，可造成严重破坏。
senses.en_definition: A violently rotating column of air extending from a cloud to the ground, often associated with a funnel cloud and capable of severe damage.
senses.ms_definition: Ribut angin yang sangat kuat dengan tiupan anginnya kencang berpusar-pusar dan menyebabkan kerosakan teruk, biasanya berlaku di Amerika Syarikat dan Australia.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义按数据包所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》展开缩写。词义对应“龙卷风”，不能把所有强风或台风都称为 tornado；释义提及的地区并非发生范围的限制。puting beliung 是相关的常用马来语称呼。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Menurut laporan awal, beberapa buah rumah rosak selepas kawasan itu dilanda tornado.
dual_scenarios.zh: 据初步报告，该地区遭龙卷风袭击后，有数间房屋受损。
dual_scenarios.en: According to the preliminary report, several houses were damaged when a tornado struck the area.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok video tornado yang aku hantar tadi?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah menonton video tornado yang saya hantar tadi?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看了我刚才发的龙卷风视频吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you watched the tornado video I sent earlier?
spoken_features: tengok 在此对应较正式的 menonton
kau 和 aku 用于熟人交流
tu 是 itu 的口语形式

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok video tornado yang aku hantar tadi?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah menonton video tornado yang saya hantar tadi?
messages.zh: 你看了我刚才发的龙卷风视频吗？
messages.en: Have you watched the tornado video I sent earlier?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, seram betul! Video tu dirakam kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, sungguh menakutkan! Video itu dirakam di mana?
messages.zh: 看了，真吓人！那视频是在哪里拍的？
messages.en: Yes, it's terrifying! Where was it filmed?

etymology.historical_story: The international word tornado has a history in English nautical descriptions of violent storms. Its earlier form ternado probably reflects Spanish tronada, meaning thunderstorm. Association with Spanish tornar, to turn, likely helped reshape the spelling. The history links thunder with rotation, but the proposed changes should not be treated as completely certain. [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/tornado).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 tor-na-do 三拍读，脑中配一幅旋转漏斗接到地面的画面：tornado＝龙卷风；声音联想只是记忆提示，不是词源拆解。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于灾害报道时语气宜客观；谈及受灾者时避免戏谑或把灾难当作猎奇话题。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻、气象说明和科学教育。转述具体事件时应区分已确认的 tornado 与尚未确认的强风现象；日常交流也常见 puting beliung。
